title: Layered backgrounds
summary: Several backgrounds in one declaration, each with its own size, position and repeat.
explanation: background-image takes a comma-separated list, and the first layer is painted on top. Here a dark fade sits over a soft yellow spotlight, which sits over a purple-to-orange gradient.

background-position, background-size and background-repeat take lists too, matched up layer by layer: the spotlight is 260px wide, pinned to the top right, and drawn once; the other two layers fill the box.
The dark fade at the bottom is what keeps the white caption readable, whatever is behind it.
tryThis: Remove the first layer (the dark fade) from background-image and from each list: the caption gets harder to read.
Change the spotlight's position from top right to center.
Change the spotlight's repeat from no-repeat to repeat.
